analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, discussing strong revenue growth driven by scalability, offline branch expansion, and core business performance. Management highlighted the near completion and launch of their digital platform, AkikoPay, on both Android and iOS stores, which will integrate insurance and mutual funds. The company revised its full-year FY27 revenue target upwards to INR325 crores to INR350 crores while maintaining confidence in achieving PAT margins of 9% to 11%. Additionally, management noted improving receivable days, a negligible impact from the Dubai business due to previous geopolitical pressure, and no near-term plans for fundraising. Akiko Global Services Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting robust operational performance across its credit card sourcing and lending businesses.

guidance.claim: Management revised the FY27 revenue guidance to a range of INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins to be between 9% and 11% for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a CAGR of 70% to 100% on a year-on-year basis for the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300 to ₹325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects 70% to 100% revenue growth for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Profit margins are expected to remain with similar profitability in FY27.
guidance.quote: And profit margins will also remain with similar profitability.

guidance.claim: The long-term vision targets INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR50 crores in revenue from AkikoPay in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Management expects a target of INR300 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The sourcing pipeline for the core business remains healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently the loan product growing the fastest.
Digital conversion rates increase significantly with a physical presence, reaching 60% to 80%.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: Dubai business has started reviving again from April onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: And, it has started reviving again from April onwards.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has added 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a comprehensive experience in the coming months.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, and others.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The number of branches across India has increased to 16.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: In unsecured loans, the average payout is 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Pressure on margins in Q4 was due to planned investments in branch expansion, technology infrastructure, and AkikoPay scale-up.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that. Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Temporary margin pressure occurred in Dubai operations due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently has a team strength of around 950 employees.
orders_capacity.quote: In the investor deck, it has been mentioned that the employee strength is around odd 950.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursement run rate has reached INR400 crores+, resulting in an annual book of INR5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: Total combined workforce including employees and channel partners has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

capital_allocation.claim: There are absolutely no plans for fundraising right now or for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from the Dubai business faced pressure during the quarter due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Temporary margin pressure in Dubai operations was driven by the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Apple App Store version will be implemented within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Integration of insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay will begin and take 2 months.
management_commitments.quote: After that version, our integration of insurance and mutual funds will begin. That will take 2 months.

management_commitments.claim: Receivable days are expected to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Upper management and CEO positions will be filled over the next 2 to 3 months.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 2 months -- 3 months, as you mentioned, those positions will be filled.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open a total of 25 new branches this year.
management_commitments.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300 to ₹325 crore with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features within this month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Everything regarding AkikoPay ecosystem integrations is expected to be visible within the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within the next quarter, you will see everything in one ecosystem.

management_commitments.claim: Ankur Gaba is expected to take on the MD or CEO position in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

management_commitments.claim: Unsecured book is targeted to reach INR1,000 crores by March 31st.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book. So, the INR400 crores is to be taken to INR1,000 crores. This is my complete vision, complete target till 31st March.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual fund and insurance products are going to be live by August onwards.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
